name: Almería (Spain)
description: White field with a red cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Almería.
history: The flag goes back to 1147, when the army of Alfonso VII, allied with Genoa, took the city and adopted the Genoese ensign, a red Saint George's cross on white; by decree of the Consejería de Gobernación y Justicia of the Junta de Andalucía in 1997 it was described as a flag 25 units long by 15 wide, white, with a plain crimson cross 5 units wide, charged with the official arms of the city.
